procedure_text: In a 0.5 I stirred apparatus, 20 g of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-sulfonylethylbenzoic acid were suspended in 150 ml of acetonitrile. At room temperature, 17.6 g of N-bromosuccinimide and 0.7 g of dibenzoyl peroxide were added and the mixture was subsequently heated to reflux. After in each case 1 h, further dibenzoyl peroxide was added in 3 portions each of 0.7 g and the mixture was stirred for a further 2 h after the last addition. After this time, HPLC analysis indicated complete conversion. After the reaction mixture had been cooled, 100 ml of a 2% sodium bisulfite solution and 300 ml of ethyl acetate were added in succession. The organic phase was removed, washed and concentrated under reduced pressure. The solid residue was suspended in 50 ml of diethyl ether and 20 ml of heptane, filtered off and dried. 28.2 g (95.6% of theory) of 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-ethylsulfonylbenzoic acid were obtained. Purity: 88% (HPLC) Melting point: 103° C.
procedure_summary: The ethylsulfonyl benzoic acid substrate is suspended in acetonitrile and the ring methyl group is brominated with N-bromosuccinimide at reflux under a dibenzoyl peroxide initiator that is replenished in further portions during the run, until HPLC shows complete conversion. The cooled mixture is quenched with aqueous sodium bisulfite, taken into ethyl acetate, concentrated under reduced pressure, and the residue is triturated with diethyl ether and heptane, filtered off and dried to give the bromomethyl acid.
notes:
Step count. A0 estimated 1 step and 1 record is emitted, so there is no A0/A2 disagreement to explain. Example 2 runs Process Variant A) only; there is no variant B here.

Heading order. The printed order is inverted relative to Example 1: [0032] Process Variant A): at line 134 is printed BEFORE the centred Preparation of 3-bromomethyl-2-chloro-4-ethylsulfonylbenzoic Acid title at lines 136 to 138, whereas Example 1 prints the preparation title first and the variant subheading after it. Recorded because it is a property of the document, not of this annotation. It changes nothing about the step, which is still the single procedure at [0033] with its characterisation at [0034].

Linkage. precursor_step is null, linkage_confirmed false and cross_reference_unresolved false. This is a single-transformation process patent, the prior-sections reaction registry is empty, and Example 2 starts from a different substrate from Example 1 with no material flowing between the two examples, so there is no precursor to point at and nothing left unresolved. The substrate's own origin is not described anywhere in the patent, which is a silence rather than an unresolved cross reference.

Dibenzoyl peroxide is charged four times, not once. 0.7 g at room temperature with the N-bromosuccinimide, then three further portions of 0.7 g at 1 h intervals, 2.8 g in total. quantity.mass_g carries the 2.8 g total and addition_profile carries the full profile. The schema holds one number for a charge the patent makes four times, and the 2.8 g total is a figure the patent never prints as such, so the single field on its own would imply a single addition that did not happen. That is a real limitation of the shape, stated here rather than papered over. Its role is reagent, not catalyst, per PROMPT-CORRECTIONS.md section 8: the closed role list has no initiator value, a catalyst is defined as not consumed, and a species replenished three times through one reaction is plainly consumed.

Temperature and heating. The mixture is heated to reflux and no reflux temperature is printed, so heating_method is reflux and temperature stays not_specified per rule 9: reflux is a heating method, not a temperature. The only temperature word in the step is At room temperature, and it qualifies the charging of the N-bromosuccinimide and the first initiator portion before heating, not the reaction itself; it is therefore recorded in those two compounds' addition_profile and not promoted to conditions.temperature. Rule 9's addition-temperature clause covers an addition temperature that is also the reaction temperature, which this is not, because the text says the mixture was subsequently heated to reflux.

time_h holds 5.0, the time at reflux: three 1 h intervals between the four initiator portions plus the 2 h stir after the last addition. What the single field cannot hold is the structure of that time. It cannot show that the 5 h is split 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 around three interventions, it cannot show that the first hour begins at reflux rather than at the initial charge, and it cannot hold the unstated time spent charging at room temperature and heating up, which the patent does not give. The addition profile on dibenzoyl peroxide carries the interval structure instead.

Reactor. Line 140 prints a 0.5 I stirred apparatus, with the litre unit set as a capital I rather than a lower case l; the EN line at 141 silently repairs it to 0.5 l (half litre). The as-printed form is kept in procedure_text and the volume, half a litre, is recorded here because no numeric field holds a reactor volume. reactor_type is stirred apparatus. The text names a stirrer without saying what kind, so per rule 9 the stirring object is left null rather than guessed at mechanical; a stirrer is fitted.

Substrate name. Line 140 prints the substrate as 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-sulfonylethylbenzoic acid, with the sulfone written backwards. sulfonylethyl names a divalent linker and cannot be a terminal ring substituent, so it is a transposition of ethylsulfonyl; the identifier used here is the A1 identifier 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-ethylsulfonylbenzoic acid, which is the order the patent's own Example 2 title prints, and the as-printed variant is carried in that compound's A1 aliases. procedure_text keeps the misprint verbatim.

Arithmetic. It closes once the purity is applied, and nothing is raised. 20 g of C10H11ClO4S, MW 262.70, is 0.07613 mol. 28.2 g at 88% HPLC purity is 24.82 g of C10H10BrClO4S, MW 341.60, or 0.07265 mol, giving 95.4% against the 95.6% printed. Uncorrected the 28.2 g alone would be 108.4% of theory, which cannot be, so the patent's stated yield is purity-corrected and the two agree to within rounding. Per rule 29's second half, no defect is invented: mass_balance_implausible and molar_mass_inconsistent are both correctly absent. The 17.6 g of N-bromosuccinimide is 1.30 equivalents and the 2.8 g of dibenzoyl peroxide 0.15 equivalents, both consistent with a benzylic bromination; no equivalents figure is written into the record because the patent states none and A1 left them null.

Drawings. There is no drawn reaction scheme anywhere in this patent. The two IMAGE_EXTRACT spans inside this section's line range, at lines 144 and 146, are the Markush formulae II and I of claim 6, printed above the claim text by the two-column layout and filed in this section only because rule 7 forbids stranding them between sections. Both carry an empty molecules list, because the vision pass correctly refused a SMILES for a generic with variable R1 and R2. They depict nothing in this example and support nothing in this record, which is why no structure reached it. Per PROMPT-CORRECTIONS.md section 3, rules 5a, 5c, 5e, 5f and 5g have no subject here and drawing_text_conflict, reagent_drawn_not_written, reagent_written_not_drawn and route_attribution_unclear are not raised: there is no drawing to conflict with the prose and no scheme to attribute to prior art or to the invention.

Other fields. conditions.concentration is left null: the only concentration printed, the 2% sodium bisulfite solution, belongs to the quench and is recorded in workup.quenching_agent and in that compound's addition_profile, not as a reaction condition. Reduced pressure is a workup operation and sets workup.concentration_method, so reaction pressure stays not_specified per rule 9. No atmosphere, no drying tube, no drying agent and no pH are stated. The wash after phase separation names no wash medium, so the medium is recorded as unnamed rather than assumed to be water. safety_notes is empty because the text makes no safety statement; the peroxide hazard is A5's business, not this pass's. byproduct_recovery is null: the succinimide by-product is neither recovered nor mentioned. selectivity is null throughout, since the patent reports no ee, de or dr and does not discuss the benzylic regiochemistry, which is only implied by the product name. step_role is tagged final_step because this single transformation delivers the section's isolated target and nothing follows it; it is equally the first transformation of the section, and the category holds one value.
